tasks.prompt: Locate the production source file that decides whether redirect requests preserve or remove Authorization headers based on request origin, including the HTTP-to-HTTPS upgrade case. Return the most relevant production file path.

Locate the production source file that defines how parameter values coming from environment variables are split into multiple values using type-specific behavior. Return the most relevant production file path.
Locate the production source file that retrieves URL route parameters from an HTTP request's routing context. Return the most relevant production file path.

Locate the production source file that decides when a browser request should read the XSRF cookie and attach the XSRF header, including the same-origin check. Return the most relevant production file path.
Locate the production source file where recursive walking can enable or disable ignoring hidden files, with hidden-file filtering enabled by default. Return the most relevant production file path.

Locate the production source file implementing asynchronous connection health checks that use PING/PONG after the configured health-check interval elapses. Return the most relevant production file path.
Locate the production source file that computes the request IP address using the application's trust-proxy configuration. Return the most relevant production file path.
Locate the production source file that retrieves route variables stored in the current HTTP request context. Return the most relevant production file path.
tasks.expected_anchor: route variables for the current request

construction_rule: Repositories and task labels were selected only after the proof-or-frontier controller was frozen. The controller has not been executed on these tasks before this file was committed.
judge_blinding: External semantic judges must not receive expected_file, expected_anchor, raw rank score, controller top-1 status, or candidate ordering significance.
freeze_rule: Do not change task prompt, repository commit, expected file, or expected anchor after first controller execution. If a fixture is invalid for reasons independent of controller performance, document the invalidity and create a new suite version rather than editing this one.
claim_boundary: This taskset tests deterministic repository localization/frontier mechanics and blind semantic selection. It is not a general software-engineering benchmark.
